name: native-migration
description: Plan, design, spike and incrementally migrate native desktop

classification.use_for: Native migration scoped to requested phase

steps.action: Read source/tests, dirty state and current migration evidence.
Create/edit UX review with task isolation and platform states.
When implementation requested, validate one vertical slice on each target OS.
Move one capability with parity and rollback checks.
Record actual gates separately for design, prototype, runtime and release.
